note: G108: every G-series arm as a margin over its own split's null, grouped by (split, candidate set) and refusing to rank across groups.

controls.name: C1_more_than_one_GROUP_exists
controls.must_fire_because: if every arm shared one split and one candidate set there would be nothing to refuse and no reason for the row
controls.can_fail_because: all arms fall in a single group
controls.null_must_contain: the group keys and their sizes

controls.name: C2_the_two_numbers_that_started_this_are_in_DIFFERENT_groups
controls.must_fire_because: my error was ranking them against each other. If they turn out to share a group, the correction is wrong and the original reading stands
controls.can_fail_because: G54's and G75's headlines share a (split, candidate set) group
controls.null_must_contain: both arms' split and candidate set

G54_headline.refused_because: the spike declares no candidate_set, so its MRR has no protocol and cannot be compared with any other arm -- guessing one would be supplying the input to my own comparison

controls.name: C3_every_ranked_arm_has_a_MEASURED_null_on_its_own_split
controls.must_fire_because: ranking an arm whose split has no null is the exact thing bar_rule forbids; the refusal list must absorb them
controls.can_fail_because: a ranked arm carries no null
controls.null_must_contain: the count ranked and the count refused

controls.name: C4_the_refusal_path_actually_FIRES
controls.must_fire_because: a scoreboard that refuses nothing has not been tested as a filter -- it would rank whatever it was handed
controls.can_fail_because: nothing is refused, so the filter is unproven
controls.null_must_contain: the refusal reasons and their counts

reasons: the spike declares no candidate_set, so its MRR has no proto
the spike declares no split this scoreboard can resolve, so

controls.name: C5_a_declared_split_disagreeing_with_its_own_n_test_is_caught
controls.must_fire_because: a split label is a claim about which triples were scored; n_test is the observable that can contradict it
controls.can_fail_because: no artifact disagrees, in which case this is a clean bill and not a finding
controls.null_must_contain: every disagreement found, or that there are none

controls.name: C6_the_arm_the_LOOP_SCORES_is_itself_unplaceable
controls.must_fire_because: the sharpest form of the row. G54's headline is what `--eval` publishes as filtered_mrr, and it declares no candidate_set -- so the number the loop maximises cannot be compared with anything, including its own successors
controls.can_fail_because: G54 declares a candidate set after all, in which case it lands on the board and this is an ordinary ranking row
controls.null_must_contain: what G54 declares and why it was refused

observations.refused_because: the spike declares no candidate_set, so its MRR has no protocol and cannot be compared with any other arm -- guessing one would be supplying the input to my own comparison
observations.consequence: the number the loop maximises cannot be placed beside any other arm in its own series

falsifiers.name: F2_the_arms_are_incomparable_even_after_pairing_with_nulls
falsifiers.can_fail_because: more than one candidate set appears among the ranked arms
falsifiers.refutes: that one ranked list across the G-series is possible
falsifiers.fires_when: more than one candidate set appears among the ranked arms

falsifiers.name: F3_an_arm_is_ranked_without_a_null_on_its_split
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any ranked arm lacks a measured null
falsifiers.refutes: that the scoreboard is trustworthy at all
falsifiers.fires_when: any ranked arm lacks a measured null
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire
